headline: B200 index rises +4% on neocloud pricing while H200's flat index hides a +8% marketplace jump.
bullets: B200's market index rose +4% to $8.55 over 7 days, driven by a +6% neocloud move to $8.50, while hyperscaler ($14.12) and marketplace ($5.98) medians held at +0%.
H200's index was +0% at $5.40, but its marketplace median climbed +8% to $4.41, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $3.59.
H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance of the 11 tracked GPUs at $3.60 per PFLOP-hour, just ahead of MI300X at $3.62 and B200 at $3.80.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium among tracked GPUs at +184%, versus +140% for H100 SXM and +66% for B200.
Lower-end marketplace pricing softened slightly, with A100 80GB SXM at -1% ($1.27) and L40S at -2% ($0.78).
watch: Whether B200's +6% neocloud increase keeps going and narrows its +66% hyperscaler premium, or whether the H200 marketplace rise of +8% spreads to the neocloud segment.
